answers.final_answer: A per-unit (Pigouvian) tax equal to the marginal external cost
answers.brief_reasoning: A per-unit tax equal to MEC makes the firm's marginal cost equal to the marginal social cost, so the firm internalizes the externality and cuts output to the socially optimal level. A lump-sum tax doesn't change marginal cost, a subsidy raises output, an income tax on consumers doesn't target the producer, and a price ceiling distorts the market without internalizing the cost.
